{{Quote|The cat becomes the mouse.|Mori the Bastard|<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
A '''mouse''' (plural: '''mice''') was a small [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]].

The ears of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] species were likened to those of a mouse.<ref name="NN">{{SWE|characters|niennunb|Nien Nunb}}</ref>

[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] of the [[MSE-series]] were nicknamed "mouse droids".<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
